concerns.text: T004 embeds an in-task escape hatch: 'if the full 50 k × 54 × 5 run exceeds it, scale to a fixed-seed real subset and state the sample size and its limitation honestly.' FR-001 mandates ≥ 50,000 clips and FR-002 mandates the ≥ 50,000 × 54 × 5 workload; a task-level discretion to shrink the study is a silent weakening of both FRs (and SC-004) with no spec amendment path. Remove the escape hatch or route it through a documented spec amendment.

T007 sets the regression target to 'inflection_step' (per regression_input.schema.yaml), but FR-005 mandates predicting the Universal Collapse Intensity (FR-036). The task tags [FR-005] while delivering a different target — a semantic weakening the deterministic FR-012 check cannot catch. Align the target (and the schema field) with FR-005/FR-036.

T009 implements a ViW-2M proxy 'as amended by plan', but no spec amendment exists: FR-018 still mandates DNS-Challenge validation with LMSD pass criterion ≤ 0.15, and the spec's Verified Datasets table lists DNS-Challenge as verified. The task also drops the ≤ 0.15 pass criterion entirely. This is an unrecorded requirement weakening; the spec must be amended (or FR-018 enforced) before the task can claim to satisfy it.

FR-033 requires regression predictions to be compared against the 500-expert-label ground truth to compute an out-of-sample R² ('independent check beyond the deterministic target'). T006 computes only precision/recall (SC-009) and never feeds the expert labels into an out-of-sample R² evaluation — a dropped acceptance criterion. Add the FR-033 out-of-sample R² check to T006/T007.

SC-004 requires the pilot to complete within 48 h and the full run within 72 h on the GPU cluster; neither T004 nor T010 records wall-time verification against these budgets. Add a timing check to T010's verification so the SC-004 criterion survives into execution.

US-3's independent test requires 'a model-agnostic SHAP analysis … to confirm the form of interaction'; no task performs SHAP (plan lists `shap` as a dependency). If SHAP is intentionally descoped, record that in the spec; otherwise add it to T007/T008.
